newsitem.title: USA: Fretter files for Chapter 11 protection.
newsitem.headline: Fretter files for Chapter 11 protection.

text.p: Fretter Inc said on Tuesday that it filed for protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
The filing was made in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Cleveland, Ohio, because the company owns a number of real estate parcels there, it said.

The discount home appliance and electronics chain had been in the process of closing all of its store locations and liquidating its assets to pay creditors. It said in a statement it had hoped a liquidation could be completed without a bankruptcy filing.
